title: Gitea

The Gitea provider works with gitea.com and self-hosted Gitea instances. It shares its implementation with the [Forgejo](/providers/forgejo) provider, so the Forgejo page applies here too, apart from the default instance and the webhook headers. Refs from this provider have `forge: 'gitea'`.

## Authentication

The provider accepts an access token:

```ts
import { gitea } from 'forges/gitea'

const forge = gitea({
  auth: { type: 'token', token: process.env.GITEA_TOKEN! },
}).create()
```

If you leave out `auth`, the provider makes anonymous reads of public data.

## Instance

The default instance is `https://gitea.com`. To use a self-hosted instance, set `baseUrl` to the root of the instance. The provider appends `/api/v1` itself:

```ts
gitea({ baseUrl: 'https://gitea.example.com', auth })
```

`refreshCapabilities()` reads the version of the instance from `/version`.

## Behaviour shared with Forgejo

Because Gitea and Forgejo share an implementation, the following sections of the Forgejo page describe Gitea as well:

- [Marking notifications done](/providers/forgejo#marking-notifications-done)
- [Merging](/providers/forgejo#merging)
- [Reviews](/providers/forgejo#reviews)
- [Changed files](/providers/forgejo#changed-files)
- [Search](/providers/forgejo#search)

## Checks and CI

`checks.list()` reads commit statuses, and `checks.report()` writes them. Gitea Actions has an API too, but its runs and jobs come in other shapes than Forgejo's, so the `ci` methods are unavailable for now.

## Webhooks

To verify deliveries, set `webhookSecret` to the secret that you configured on the hook:

```ts
const forge = gitea({
  webhookSecret: process.env.GITEA_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
}).create()

const events = await forge.webhooks.ingest({
  headers: request.headers,
  body: await request.text(),
})
```

With each delivery, Gitea sends these headers:

| Header | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `X-Gitea-Signature` | The hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body |
| `X-Gitea-Event` | The event name |
| `X-Gitea-Delivery` | The delivery ID |

Unlike the Forgejo provider, the Gitea provider doesn't read `X-Forgejo-*` headers.

A label delivery doesn't say which labels were added or removed. When the set of labels changes, the provider reports a `label` event with the `edited` action, and when every label is removed, a `label` event with the `unlabelled` action.
